description: Test class for the InvokeDispatcher component in the ai.openclaw.app.node package. Contains unit tests verifying behavior of command handling, feature availability checks, and permission handling in the InvokeDispatcher using Robolectric framework.

classes.name: InvokeDispatcherTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for InvokeDispatcher testing various command and feature availability scenarios.

methods.name: classifySmsSearchAvailability_returnsAvailable_whenReadSmsIsAvailable
methods.description: Test verifying that SMS search is reported as available when read permissions and feature are enabled.

methods.name: classifySmsSearchAvailability_returnsUnavailable_whenSmsFeatureDisabled
methods.description: Test verifying SMS search is unavailable if the SMS feature is disabled.

methods.name: classifySmsSearchAvailability_returnsUnavailable_whenTelephonyUnavailable
methods.description: Test verifying SMS search is unavailable when telephony features are not available.

methods.name: classifySmsSearchAvailability_returnsPermissionRequired_whenOnlyReadSmsPermissionIsMissing
methods.description: Test for reporting permission requirement when read SMS permission is missing despite other features being enabled.

methods.name: smsSearchAvailabilityError_returnsNull_whenReadSmsPermissionIsRequestable
methods.description: Test that error is null when SMS search permission can be requested.

methods.name: smsSearchAvailabilityError_returnsUnavailable_whenSmsSearchIsImpossible
methods.description: Test that error correctly indicates SMS is unavailable on device.

methods.name: handleInvoke_allowsRequestableSmsSearchToReachHandler
methods.description: Test that handleInvoke allows SMS search command when permissions and features are in place.

methods.name: handleInvoke_blocksSmsSearchWhenFeatureIsUnavailable
methods.description: Test that handleInvoke blocks SMS search when feature is disabled.

methods.name: handleInvoke_allowsAvailableSmsSendToReachHandler
methods.description: Test that handleInvoke permits sending SMS when allowed.

methods.name: handleInvoke_blocksSmsSendWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Test that handleInvoke blocks SMS send when feature is unavailable.

methods.name: handleInvoke_blocksCameraCommandsWhenCameraDisabled
methods.description: Test that camera commands are blocked if camera is disabled.

methods.name: handleInvoke_blocksLocationCommandWhenLocationDisabled
methods.description: Test that location commands are blocked if location is disabled.

methods.name: handleInvoke_blocksMotionActivityWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Test that motion activity commands are blocked if motion activity is unavailable.

methods.name: handleInvoke_blocksMotionPedometerWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Test that motion pedometer commands are blocked if not available.

methods.name: handleInvoke_blocksCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Test that call log commands are blocked if call log access is unavailable.

methods.name: handleInvoke_treatsDebugCommandsAsUnknownOutsideDebugBuilds
methods.description: Test that debug commands are rejected outside debug builds.
